          SPECIMEN 01 / HEIGHT ENCODING
        

      


      

        
CHAIN OF CUSTODY
No peeking between models.

        
    
          
  1. 01
    Hider draws SVG
    The chosen LLM encodes the message through visual structure, not visible text.
    2. 
          
  2. 02
    Browser burns the source
    GhostFrame rasterizes the SVG into a PNG. Code, element names, and comments do not cross the boundary.
    3. 
          
  3. 03
    Fresh seeker sees pixels
    A new multimodal call receives only the image and a neutral forensic prompt.
    4. 
          
  4. 04
    Score stays inspectable
    The app normalizes both messages, calculates edit-distance similarity, and shows the full model response.
    5.
